headline: Your Google card is up with your address, phone, and hours. The website linked from Nextdoor no longer exists.
summary: Carl's Boot & Leather Shop at 862 N 2nd St in El Cajon repairs boots, shoes, saddles, and tack, does custom leather work, and keeps a small counter of boots and tack. Nextdoor named the shop a Neighborhood Favorite in 2024 and 2025. Google Maps has a card with your address, phone, and hours. The leftover is the website: your Nextdoor page links carlsbootandleathershop.com, and that address no longer exists, so the link goes nowhere. Your Google card has no website at all and shows an Add website prompt.

signals.note: Google Maps shows Carl's Boot & Leather Shop, Shoe repair shop, 862 N 2nd St, El Cajon, CA 92021, with (619) 442-3027 and hours. Google showed Open, closes 5 PM, when we checked.
signals.next: Nothing to change on the basics.

signals.note: Google and Nextdoor both list (619) 442-3027. Nextdoor also lists gleisch@cox.net.

Google showed Tuesday 9 AM to 5 PM when we checked, the same as Nextdoor. Nextdoor lists Monday to Friday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM, and Sunday closed. An online directory lists Monday as closed.
signals.next: Make sure Google and Nextdoor show Monday the way you want it.
Add a fresh shot of a finished saddle or boot repair now and then.

signals.note: Your Nextdoor page links carlsbootandleathershop.com. That address no longer exists, so the link goes nowhere. The Google card has no website and shows an Add website prompt.
signals.next: Either bring the site back or point Nextdoor to the Google card, and remove the dead link.

signals.note: Name, address, and phone match on Google and Nextdoor. Only the website link is out of date.
signals.next: Update the website field on Nextdoor once you decide where it should point.
